card.name: Second digit of percentages in trial results
card.fires_on: A digit that is the last or second digit of a percentage, written just before the % sign. It appears in adverse-event or incidence rates in clinical trial text.

modes.label: Two-digit percent
modes.description: The second digit of a whole-number percentage of patients with an event.
modes.example: 31% of patients treated with 0.4 mg/day and 3<<8>>% treated with 0.2 mg

modes.label: Decimal percent
modes.description: A digit after the decimal point in an incidence rate.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated to this pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the final digit of a percentage, such as the 8 in 38%, in trial results.
